unit: distinct V2 DEVELOPMENT economic identities whose economic outcome is opened

derivation.base_breadth_basis: up to two materially distinct structural exemplars across up to two informative contexts per mechanism family; this is an upper allocation basis, not a quota or grid
derivation.reasoning: The frozen space is materially broader than the currently reusable DEVELOPMENT data. The cap permits broad first-pass information gathering plus limited prospectively justified replication/ML/new-domain work while deliberately constraining parameter-search and multiple-testing burden far below the combinatorial cross-product.

rules: The budget is a ceiling, not a target; unused identities need not be consumed.
No automatic inheritance of the legacy 256-slot convention.
No enlargement merely because no survivor appears.
No cosmetic duplicates, threshold spam, lookback grids or minor hold variants to consume remaining budget.

A future revision is permitted only prospectively before outcomes beyond the then-current frozen budget and only for an independent methodological reason such as a genuinely new data domain or method class, never failure chasing.
A proven implementation-invalid rerun with identical semantics does not consume a new identity.
